design.positive: Question, proposed answer, and evidence are matched.
design.wrong_source: Half preserve the entity but swap to a sibling relation; half preserve the relation but use a sibling entity.
design.unknown: An unseen subject is paired with same-relation evidence from a known subject.
design.lexical_adversary: Every negative proposed answer is an exact evidence span and every evidence row overlaps the query enough to enter LiveMemory.
design.vocabulary_control: Every WRONG_SOURCE evidence/answer also appears in a positive case; labels cannot be read from answer vocabulary alone.
